Meta.title: {first} & {second}
Meta.description: We're getting married. Here's everything you need to know.

Story.title: Our story
Story.p1: We matched on Mutual in December 2023. Tayna liked KAJ first, so he swiped up too, and she sent the first message. We talked for a few weeks.
Story.p2: Then life took us in different directions: Tayna served as an FSY counselor and started her mission, and KAJ got busy with work and school at BYU.
Story.p3: Later, KAJ was accepted into a BYU internship at the University of São Paulo, with a full-ride scholarship, and posted about it on his story. Tayna messaged him: “Congrats, you’re going to love it!” She asked what he was most excited for and whether he’d ever been to Brazil. We haven’t stopped talking since.
Story.p4: After two or three months, we knew this was something completely different. As soon as the internship ended, KAJ went to visit Tayna in her hometown, Vitória da Conquista, in Bahia.
Story.p5: We’d already talked about marriage, so KAJ bought the ring before the trip to make sure he had it in time. But the day he bought it, he was so nervous that he avoided Tayna all day, until she finally asked, “Are you mad at me or what?” He couldn’t keep the secret: “I bought a ring. I’m going to propose to you later.”
Story.p6: And he did. On August 16, 2025, at sunset, overlooking the rolling hills just outside Vitória da Conquista, Tayna said yes. Now we can’t wait to spend the rest of forever together.

Schedule.title: The day
Schedule.sealingNote: By invitation only. A small, sacred ceremony with close family.
Schedule.ringNote: A short, intimate ceremony right before the reception.
Schedule.receptionNote: First dances and a few words, then lots of dancing. Come and go as you please.

dance.title: Come ready to dance
dance.body: We both love to dance and we love good music. Bring your dancing shoes and have a great time with us.

comeGo.title: Come and go as you please
comeGo.body: We’ll start with our first dances and a few words. After that, stay as long as you like.

sayHi.title: Come say hi
sayHi.body: Please come find us and introduce yourself, especially if we haven’t met yet (or it’s been a while!). We’re so excited to get to know each other’s families and friends. And we love hugs, so come give us one.

food.title: Light refreshments
food.body: We’ll have light refreshments like sliders, fruit, veggies and snacks. Come hungry for a bite, but please don’t plan on a full meal.

dressCode.soon: We'll share the dress code soon.

kids.a: Yes, kids are welcome! We just ask that they please be reverent and respectful.

photos.a: Yes, please take as many as you can! On the day you'll be able to scan a QR code and add them to our shared album.

gifts.a: Yes! Having you there is the best gift, but if you'd like to give something, our registry has a few ideas.

sealing.a: A sealing is how members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints are married in the temple, for time and all eternity. It’s a small ceremony by invitation only. We can’t wait to celebrate with everyone at the reception!

food.a: Yes, light refreshments like sliders, fruit, veggies and snacks. It won’t be a full meal, so please plan accordingly.

airport.q: Traveling in? Which airport should I fly into?
airport.a: The wedding is in Provo, Utah. The closest major airport is Salt Lake City International (SLC), about 45 minutes north by car.

hotels.a: There are lots of hotels in Provo and nearby Orem.

Registry.title: Registry
Registry.intro: Having you with us is what matters most. If you'd like to give a gift, here are a few things that would help us build our home together.
Registry.fundsIntro: Prefer to give toward something bigger? Here's what we're saving for.

give.title: Ways to give
give.intro: Send a gift with any of these, and add a note saying which fund it's for (like “Honeymoon”).
give.boxBody: Prefer cash or a card? We'll have a card box at the reception.

Registry.otherBody: These are just ideas. If you see something you think we'd love, we'd be thrilled with anything chosen with you in mind.
